assumptions: Each mobile pool initially equals its own baseline value one, with synthesis balancing native loss.
A constant persistent pool has no influx or efflux during this horizon.
Drug action switches off immediately at withdrawal; retention and target recovery are excluded here.
After withdrawal the original source and native loss resume, while added loss stops.
Cell population and tissue function are unchanged; cell division, export and chemical destruction are not separately modeled.
Old pigment means material present initially, with no recycling of its label into new pigment.
Total inventory is assumed measurable; actual optical color can add further ambiguity.
